method: Every amenity=fuel station of the eight chapter districts compared with official Street View panoramas (ids cited; imagery not stored). remainingEstimates.pumpIslands: Pump-island count and positions are the generic model at every station (e.g. Pipera Petrom shows about four islands, two are drawn; Unirii MOL four drawn, not counted): the islands are not mapped in OSM and a panorama gives no plan.
remainingEstimates.pylons: Reviewed pylon places are estimates from the panorama bearing and apparent distance (±10 m).
remainingEstimates.shops: Shop fronts / kiosks under the canopies (Pipera Petrom, Grozăvești Petrom, Unirii OMV curved shop canopy) are not modelled: no OSM outline of their own.
remainingEstimates.soffits: Canopy soffits render dark tan in shade although white in every panorama: lighting of downward faces, not their colour (#eeeeea).
remainingEstimates.flagMasts: Flag masts at Otopeni Gazprom / Rompetrol are not drawn: no OSM object.
